nodes.text: This is a sad day for all of M.A.N.. We let the brothers down.

nodes.text: I don't think it was `that` bad...

nodes.text: Yeah, yeah. There'll be plenty of time for that. For now, can we at least enjoy the O.M.G. party?

nodes.text_bbcode: Break it up out here, break it up! What do you flip flappers think you're doing fighting on [i]my[/i] field?!

nodes.text: Uh, what happens now?

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: We run!
Later, back at the M.A.N. frat house...

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: I'll say one thing for you, $USR. Never a dull moment with you, man.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Vroom... `Vroom!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Vroom... [i]Vroom![/i]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You are creeping me out!
He steps forward and swings at you again!
Trey's fist hits you in the stomach! You fall back!

nodes.speaker: Logan
nodes.text: Oof.
You duck under Trey's wild swing and punch him! He flies back!
Two more guys come at you, and you dodge around them, throwing your shoulder into one and knocking the other back with a punch!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: Nice moves, $USR.
Score Up!

nodes.text: No one messes with my friends.
Around the field, all of the B.R.B. and G.U.Y. brothers are on the ground.

nodes.speaker: Lisa

You wind back then swing your fist forward...

Trey's fist hits you in the stomach! You fall back!

nodes.speaker: Logan

You duck under Trey's wild swing and take a step back.

Around you, the frat brothers glance up...

nodes.text: That was very reasonable of you, $USR.

nodes.text: Violence should only be a last resort.

Trey punches James in the face!

You lose! Bryce walks up and takes his helmet off.

nodes.text: That was rough...
I'm not going to say that it was a success.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: Pathetic! We've disgraced M.A.N..

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Aw, good game, bros! Good game. Looks like M.A.N. has really fallen off its high horse.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Come over here, J-Dawg. I want to shake the hand of the man who brought about the downfall of M.A.N..

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: Back off, bro.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We'll see you on the field.
Trey snickers and walks off.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm going `up?`

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm going `drown?`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm going [i]drown?[/i]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Seriously? You can't even get that right?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Bryce and I are pros. You don't stand a chance.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe. Or maybe we've got enough ringers to crush you. Only one way to find out!

nodes.speaker: Zoe

nodes.text: Well, okay! It's what the ladies like anyway.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Um... Er... I mean...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Nice. Who taught this kid how to trash talk?
I mean... Er...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: Get it together, $USR! You're making us look bad!

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: This is embarrassing to watch.

nodes.speaker: Coach

nodes.speaker: Coach

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well, we got the frat printer to cough up twenty copies of the handout in black and white...

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: This is going to be a rough day.
James enters the room with a sigh. He holds a half-eaten bag of chips in one hand and two cans of soda in the other.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: Well. Time's up. The event's starting! We've got to go. We'll just have to figure it out once we get there.
Later that day, at the Pre-Rush Extravaganza...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: This table is pathetic. Can you at least spread out those chips?

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Dude, there's only like ten chips in this bowl. It's not going to look good no matter what I do.
Next to the M.A.N. table, the B.R.B. brothers have an inflatable slip and slide, video games, and a full spread of food and drinks out.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That's my game console.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: This is crap. Can't we just steal it all back?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: You want to start a fight in the middle of P.R.E.? We'll get kicked out of the event.
Oh, great. And here come the B.R.B. brothers.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: James. B-man. $USR-bro. Dontae's Inferno.
Those are not our nicknames.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I don't know, mine was kind of cool...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: Dontae, get it together. Trey, get out of here.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Whoa, easy, bro!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: You trash our stuff and steal our food and expect us to be cool?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, just a little friendly pranking!

nodes.text: This is more than just a prank.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Awww... Are you gonna cry about it?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Maybe we'll call campus security.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sure. Then all the incoming freshies will know you as the frat that went crying to the cops the second things got rough.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: ...This isn't over.
Just then, you spot a familiar face in the crowd talking to one of the B.R.B. brothers!

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: ...So you're saying that you have a party `every` Friday night? Pretty sweet...
nodes.text_bbcode: ...So you're saying that you have a party [i]every[/i] Friday night? Pretty sweet...

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: Hey! Hector! Over here!

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: $USR! Hey, man!

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: Checking out the frats?

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: Looking for the great Mu Alpha Nu that everyone's told me so much about.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: Hey, I remember you. You and your friends came to our Halloween party, right?

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: That's right. And if M.A.N. lives up to that, I'm definitely going to pledge with you guys.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, I'd think that over if I were you, freshie. You've got `lots` of options. Beta Rho Beta would be happy to have a guy like you.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, I'd think that over if I were you, freshie. You've got [i]lots[/i] of options. Beta Rho Beta would be happy to have a guy like you.

nodes.text: And word has it that M.A.N. is kind of falling apart. I mean, look at this table!
Hector and the other freshmen glance around at the other decked-out tables and then back at M.A.N.'s bowl of ten chips.

nodes.speaker: Trey
nodes.text: He does have a point.
Hector, don't listen to this guy.

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: Yeah, I'm sure they're still getting set up, right, $USR?

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: Um... Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: I knew it! You guys have something epic planned, don't you?
Just then, you hear a voice calling to you...
You punch in her number, and the phone starts ringing... Then...

nodes.text: Hello? What's up, $USR? I can't talk long, there's been a mix up with our P.R.E. event today, and I accidentally sent a bunch of admits to a poetry reading instead of our house...

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: We're kind of dealing with a crisis of our own. The B.R.B. brothers messed up our table.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: That's terrible! I'm so sorry, $USR.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: I've got to run, but I'll try to drop by your table. Maybe I can bring some of our extra supplies for the P.R.E. party tonight.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: That would be amazing. Thanks!
You punch in her number, and the phone starts ringing... Then...

nodes.speaker: Shane
nodes.text: $USR? What's up? I can't talk long. I'm at that admit weekend poetry reading event, remember?

nodes.speaker: Shane
nodes.text: Yeah, sorry to interrupt... But I was hoping you could help.

nodes.speaker: Shane
nodes.text: What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Shane
nodes.text: You know our big admit weekend table for the P.R.E. event? The B.R.B. brothers stole our food and trashed our stuff. We're scrambling to put something together.

nodes.speaker: Shane
nodes.text: Those jerks! I can't believe they did that!

nodes.speaker: Shane
nodes.text: Oh no, I'm up... Sorry, $USR. Got to go. Look, I don't know if there's much I can do. This whole frat business isn't really my thing... But I'll try to stop by after I'm done here!

nodes.speaker: Shane
nodes.text: Thanks. Good luck.
You punch in her number, and the phone starts ringing... Then...

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Oh, right... I forgot your new action movie started filming today.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: No prob. What's up?

nodes.speaker: James

nodes.speaker: James

nodes.text: Yeah... But I want to see you. Maybe I can drop by real quick sometime in between my seminar and my flight?

nodes.subtitle: How will everyone do on their first day of Centerscore University?

nodes.text: You are now playing as Hector.
It's Registration Weekend at Centerscore University!
Sam, $ZOE, Hector, and Amanda walk towards a big group of tents where student registration and organization signups are happening!

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: We're here! Yeah! I can't believe it! Today's such a big day!

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: Yeah, the biggest!

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: ...Wait, why is it the biggest again?

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: We're on a college campus `as` college students! This is huge! We figure out who we are, what we want...
nodes.text_bbcode: We're on a college campus [i]as[/i] college students! This is huge! We figure out who we are, what we want...

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: `Where` we want to party!
nodes.text_bbcode: [i]Where[/i] we want to party!

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: Yay, parties!
Uh-huh. I thought you guys were here to sign up for classes. You know, since it's registration time?

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: Pffft, $ZOE. Classes? There's plenty of time for that later. College is about having fun!

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: And I know exactly where the fun is. `That's` where Amanda and I are going.
nodes.text_bbcode: And I know exactly where the fun is. [i]That's[/i] where Amanda and I are going.

nodes.text: Hector points at some booths where large Greek letters display the names of the fraternities and sororities on campus.

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: You two coming with us?

nodes.text: I wish. Unfortunately, since I'm here on that Shakespeare scholarship, I actually have to meet up with Ms. Macbeth and the other winners. We're going to do a seminar or something.

nodes.text: Oh no, not that! I `hate` ghosts!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh no, not that! I [i]hate[/i] ghosts!

nodes.text: What are `you` talking about?
nodes.text_bbcode: What are [i]you[/i] talking about?

nodes.text: She said seminar, not `seance,` Amanda.
nodes.text_bbcode: She said seminar, not [i]seance,[/i] Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: Oh! In that case, yay!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Thanks, I guess.
Anyway, Sam's due at the theater soon, so we're going to go look for it. Catch you guys later?

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: Yeah! Have fun!

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: Which sorority do you want to look at first, Amanda?

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: The friendliest one!
Tina from the O.M.G. booth comes up to Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Hey you! You look like you could be in a sorority!

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: I do?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Yeah! And O.M.G.'s the sorority to be in! With us, you'll have a super fun time!

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: I love that acronym! And I love super fun times!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Come to our recruitment activity! The address is on this flyer, and it's starting soon!
Tina hands a flyer to Amanda before wandering off to flag down some other cute girls.

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: You going to check it out?

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: Yeah! She seemed pretty friendly!

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: Okay. So, I'm off to M.A.N.'s booth at the activity fair, and then I'll pick you up at O.M.G. later, yeah?

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: Of course!

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: And Amanda, if `anything` out of the ordinary happens, you'll call?
nodes.text_bbcode: And Amanda, if [i]anything[/i] out of the ordinary happens, you'll call?

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: I always call when something out of the ordinary happens!

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: I'm not talking about you seeing a butterfly!

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: That was `one` time, and it was blue!
nodes.text_bbcode: That was [i]one[/i] time, and it was blue!

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: You left me five voicemails about it!

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: Hee! That was a great day... Anyway, bye bye! I love you!
Amanda rushes off.

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: Time to man it up at M.A.N.!
Hector sets his sights on the fraternity booths, where raging party music is playing.

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: This is going to be awesome! I can't wait to see what M.A.N. is up to...

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Hey, $USR! Lookin' sharp. Ready for the big Pre-Rush Extravaganza?

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Of course. We spent all last week prepping, didn't we?

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Yeah... For a guy who loves to party, James is hardcore about this stuff.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: Hey! I heard that. Come on, gentlemen. The honorable reputation of Mu Alpha Nu is on the line! This Pre-Rush Extravaganza sets the tone for the entire year!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: The frat that looks the best at the Pre-Rush Extravaganza gets the best pledges... And every year, we crush the P.R.E.! I'm not about to let our fraternity down.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah. I think you can relax now, buddy. We've got it all set up. Posters, the inflatable slip and slide, food, drinks, video games... Our table's even already set up in the quad.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Besides, the other frats don't even take this seriously. Beta Rho Beta is the only frat that even comes close, and I haven't even seen them prepping. They've totally slacked off this year.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: And you `know` we've got the yearly football scrimmage locked down. Between me and $USR, we've got an unstoppable team.
nodes.text_bbcode: And you [i]know[/i] we've got the yearly football scrimmage locked down. Between me and $USR, we've got an unstoppable team.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: Heh. Honestly, I'm glad we're going to blow all the other frats away. Our old high school buddy Hector is going to be here today.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Hector's coming? Sweet! There's nothing like impressing your old friends with your new life.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: It's not just about showing off. Hector's a really cool guy. He belongs in M.A.N., and I want to make sure he has a good impression of the frat, so he'll pledge with us!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Crisis! Disaster!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: Slow down, man. What happened?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I was just at the table to check on everything for the P.R.E., and it's terrible!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: The B.R.B. brothers raided our stuff! They took all the games and food and drinks and even the slip and slide! Anything they didn't take, they `trashed!`
nodes.text_bbcode: The B.R.B. brothers raided our stuff! They took all the games and food and drinks and even the slip and slide! Anything they didn't take, they [i]trashed![/i]

nodes.text: Uh oh.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Just give him a second.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: And... Here we go.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Macbeth
nodes.text: Scramble the troops! Start printing new handouts! Call up everyone you know! `This is a code red emergency!`

nodes.text: James runs out of the room.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Uh, I guess we'll get on that printing? $USR, call in some backup. What about your girlfriend? Maybe she can help.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: All right, enough of that.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Masterful! Next up... Trisha and Joshua...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: Maybe you're not a complete disgrace...

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Just try to keep up.

nodes.text: Hmph.

nodes.speaker: Photo 1
nodes.text: What a combination! Well, that sounds dreadfully magnificent! I look forward to seeing it in the fall!

nodes.text: And this concludes our first meeting. See you all on the first week of the new school year!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: No problem.

nodes.text: So I'm heading to a party right now. It's supposed to be the hottest one on campus! Want to come?

menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: We could do a musical that makes a statement.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: Really? A serious musical? `That's` your brilliant compromise?
nodes.text_bbcode: Really? A serious musical? [i]That's[/i] your brilliant compromise?

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: What's wrong with it?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: You can't make a musical serious.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Yes, you can. There are several about wars and tragedy!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: It sounds ridiculous.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: It `sounds` amazing! Does everyone else like it?
nodes.text_bbcode: It [i]sounds[/i] amazing! Does everyone else like it?

nodes.text: Excited agreements fly around the room!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: What about unique? Musicals that have been done aren't that unique.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Then we'll write our own.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: That's... Acceptable.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Great! I'll go tell Ms. Macbeth!
There's silence for a moment as everyone digests this. Then--

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: Hamlet and Zombies?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: Are you seriously suggesting that we make a mockery of Shakespeare?

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: No, I'm suggesting we do something serious and fun!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Hamlet is serious. Besides, we're the Shakespeare scholarship winners.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: Hamlet is overrated and overdone.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Zombies are fun.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Or, at least `I` think they are.
nodes.text_bbcode: Or, at least [i]I[/i] think they are.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: I hate to say it, but I don't love zombies. I don't even `like` them.
nodes.text_bbcode: I hate to say it, but I don't love zombies. I don't even [i]like[/i] them.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Plus, zombie movies aren't particularly `fun.` They're scary!
nodes.text_bbcode: Plus, zombie movies aren't particularly [i]fun.[/i] They're scary!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Yeah! Scarily fun!
Our project would be scary `and` serious. I don't like that!
nodes.text_bbcode: Our project would be scary [b]and[/b] serious. I don't like that!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: Yeah, `terrible` idea, Sam!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, [i]terrible[/i] idea, Sam!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: All those in favor of voting `Sam` out of this vote...
nodes.text_bbcode: All those in favor of voting [i]Sam[/i] out of this vote...

nodes.text: Everyone, including Trisha, raises their hand.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Hey! I didn't even know that was an option!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: It is now... Now, get out!
Sam turns away, her head bowed.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Well, I tried... Theater just wasn't ready for my ideas...
Sam trudges away, knowing in her heart...

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: But Hawk and I are due in Australia for a new movie we're filming, and we have a long plane flight ahead of us!

nodes.speaker: Coach Graw
nodes.text: The Hawk is best when in the air.
Sam can't think of anything romantic! Her mind gives her $ZOE, Howard, and Erik!
When she turns to Logan, she shakes his hand politely. He pulls away from her before speaking.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: `Samantha, my love... You are a wondrous thing...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [i]Samantha, my love... You are a wondrous thing...[/i]

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: `How lucky I am to have you in my life, my dear...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [i]How lucky I am to have you in my life, my dear...[/i]

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: `Uh, no luckier than I am to have you, old buddy, old pal...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [i]Uh, no luckier than I am to have you, old buddy, old pal...[/i]

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: `We're the best of friends, aren't we?`
nodes.text_bbcode: [i]We're the best of friends, aren't we?[/i]

nodes.text: Logan frowns, but leans in and hugs her. Sam gives him an awkward pat on the back in return.
There's scattered applause as the scene ends.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Uh, that was... Confusing. Sam, it was `romantic`, not `friendly.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, that was... Confusing. Sam, it was [i]romantic[/i], not [i]friendly.[/i]

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: Unsurprising.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: What am I even doing here? I hate proving Logan right!
Sam is about to retort back, but Ms. Macbeth clears her throat!

nodes.speaker: Photo 1
nodes.text: Hello, everyone! Welcome, welcome! We'll be starting our seminar very shortly!
Logan's attention turns to Ms. Macbeth instead. Trisha bumps her shoulder against Sam's.

nodes.speaker: Photo 1
nodes.text: Try not to let him upset you. I think you could do very well in this program.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: You seem very composed!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Sorry you had to meet someone like Logan on the first day.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Having experience certainly helps in this field...

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: But I'm sure you'll find your footing soon enough!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Not with people like Logan around. He's a real...

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Thespian?

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: ...Yeah.
At the front, Ms. Macbeth gives a friendly smile to everyone.

nodes.speaker: Photo 1
nodes.text: I'd like to welcome everyone here today! It's so deliciously exciting to see the promise and potential in every one of you!

nodes.speaker: Photo 1
nodes.text: Before classes officially start, it's nice to break the ice and give everyone a chance to act with one another. We have some veterans here who you may know...
Ms. Macbeth steps aside to reveal two very famous celebrities!

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Hello, Centerscore U!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: It's Lisa!

nodes.speaker: Coach Graw
nodes.text: The Hawk is in the house! Hawk-aw!
And Hawk Gunner! He's so hot!

nodes.speaker: Photo 1
nodes.text: Lisa and Hawk will be running a short seminar for us today.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: I'm very grateful to be here today. Acting is an expression of the soul. When people see you on stage or in movies, they're really taken out of themselves. They're experiencing life from a different perspective.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: It's up to us as actors to make people believe. For today, we'll just do a very quick exercise. You're going to act out a pure emotion with someone else.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: The key to doing that is to conjure up a powerful memory associated with that emotion and to let it flow through you as you act.

nodes.speaker: Coach Graw
nodes.text: The Hawk will pair you into chicklets and guys. Then he will pick out the emotion you will be demonstrating!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Seriously?

nodes.speaker: Coach Graw
nodes.text: We'll start with you--
Hawk points at Logan.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Please don't pick me...

nodes.speaker: Coach Graw
nodes.text: And you!
Hawk points at Sam.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: Ugh.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Great.

nodes.speaker: Coach Graw
nodes.text: You come up in front of everyone. You will be acting out the dance of `romance!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You come up in front of everyone. You will be acting out the dance of [i]romance![/i]

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: Literally?
Lisa comes up next to them.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: No on the dance, but yes, on the romance! You two will pretend to be in love!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: So do I get lines or something?

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Nope! It's entirely on the spot, and you just say what comes to you!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: I don't know if--

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: --If you can do this? I'm not surprised.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: No. I was going to say I don't know if I could wait another second. Let's do this!
The other students quiet down to watch Sam and Logan.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: All right, Lisa wants me to think of some powerful memories? Well, the most romantic memories I've got are with the three guys I've made out with... All I have to do is think of Colt, Spencer, and Nick!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: It's not enough to have talent. You need something `else.`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's not enough to have talent. You need something [i]else.[/i]

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Like what?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: In your case, maybe a little style, a dash of panache, and a serious makeover.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: I can makeover your face.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: A crude comeback if there ever there was one.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: Talent without sophistication won't carry you in a demanding program like this.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: Passion? What so great about that?

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Talent's not enough. If you want to be good, you have to be passionate about it and willing to work hard.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: I can get experience...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: But I was born with passion.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Very nice.
This quiets Logan down for exactly one second before he sneers at Sam.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: All right. Fine. We'll just see how far `passion` can carry you in a demanding program like this.
nodes.text_bbcode: All right. Fine. We'll just see how far [i]passion[/i] can carry you in a demanding program like this.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: You have what?

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Um...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: Well, you clearly don't have a way with words.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: No, but I do have, uh, talent! Raw talent!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: Did you say 'real actors'?
Sam and Trisha turn to see a tall, cute guy next to them.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: Hey, I'm Logan. Please tell me you both have some actual acting experience.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: Kind of. I studied some acting at the Georgette School for the Arts.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: Nice. I hear they have a decent acting program there.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: My favorite class was Methods for the Method Actor. Where'd you go?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: I went to the Cantor Acting Academy.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: Whoa, that's a really prestigious program! I mean, like a whole other level of fantastical!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: Yeah, you could say I've broken a leg or two.
Sam laughs.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Is that really a phrase?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: And where did you study acting?

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: I went to Twin Branches High.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: What art school is that?

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: It's... Not. It's a public school in Centerscore.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: So you have zero acting experience?

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: I've been in a play before. And I got into this scholarship program, didn't I?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: Oh yeah? What was your scholarship project?

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: A rendition of Romeo and Juliet--

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: Arguably Shakespeare's least important play.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: --I changed the roles and scenes around. I was Tybalt, and I made the kiss the last scene in the play. Ms. Macbeth thought it was fascinating.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: Ms. Macbeth appreciates the romantic. But all in all, you didn't really rewrite anything, did you? You just moved things around.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Fine, hotshot. What did `you` do?
nodes.text_bbcode: Fine, hotshot. What did [i]you[/i] do?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: I made a modern-day version of Shakespeare's Julius Caesar using current political figures instead of the classic Roman ones.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: I also wrote in and acted a scathing political soliloquy, and my performance was lauded by no less than three critics in the theater world.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Huh.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: Yeah. Impressive, isn't it? So you perform in one high school play, and suddenly, you think you're a professional?

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: I didn't say I was a professional. And so what if I don't have as much acting experience as you do?

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: I have...

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Of course!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Why else would I be here?

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Yeah. I knew that. That was dumb.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: It's good to be certain, I guess. I'd hate it if I were just with a bunch of people who didn't really like theater and did the scholarship just for money.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Yeah.
It's great to finally be surrounded by real actors!
Trisha's face lights up.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: I kind of always knew I'd be an actress, you know? When I was little, I loved being the center of attention!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: I used to put on these plays for my family and make them watch on every holiday.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: In high school, I joined the acting club, and the rest is history!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: So you've probably spent a ton of time onstage, huh?

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: That's the real shame. I haven't actually. My high school was really big, and my director wanted everyone to take turns acting out the main characters.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: There was a rule about not being able to be the star of a show twice in a row, so it was hard to get spots. I've probably only been in about two major productions.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Sad, isn't it?

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Not at all. I've only been in one major production. It was the Shakespeare production that got me this scholarship.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Oh good! We're about even then!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Yeah, and here I was worried that I didn't have enough experience.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: You must have been good enough to get here. This isn't an easy program to get into!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: I'm so happy to be here! It's so wonderful being surrounded by real actors!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Do you like theater?

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Although I guess I don't really know if it's nice to meet you or not since, well, we've just met!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: But I look forward to getting to see if it `is` nice to meet you.
nodes.text_bbcode: But I look forward to getting to see if it [i]is[/i] nice to meet you.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Whoa, what?

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Sorry, I'm kind of a rambler. And I'm a total goof at things like this.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: I'm just all excited, you know? Nervous, but `really` excited!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm just all excited, you know? Nervous, but [i]really[/i] excited!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: I'm sure we all are.
A silence lapses between them, and Sam tries to think of something to ask.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: So...

options.label: How did you get into theater?

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Short for Samantha.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Nice. I'm Trisha, short for Trisha!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Ha ha.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: It's nice to meet you, Sam.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Sadie? What a cool name.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Ugh, this is embarrassing. Why did I say the wrong name?
Sam briefly considers going by 'Sadie' for the entirety of her college career...
And decides to speak up.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Actually, sorry, it's Sam.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Not Sadie?

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: I wish. Because that would have meant I didn't forget my name just now.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: We're all actors here. Maybe you were thinking of a past role you did.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: ...Yeah. Let's go with that.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Well, it's nice to meet `you,` Sam.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, it's nice to meet [i]you,[/i] Sam.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Um... My name is Sadie?
You are now playing as Sam.
Rewinding back to the beginning of the day when Sam and $ZOE leave Amanda and Hector...
Sam is consulting a map on her phone as they wander further onto the Centerscore campus.

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: Where do you think the stupid theater department is?
Maybe that place on the map called the Brownell Theater for the Arts?

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: You know what? You're kind of useful to have around.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: I try.
They set off in that direction.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: I'm so excited that I got to come with you on your first day of school!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Technically, it's not my first day. It's just the first day I'm on campus.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Same thing! You came with me to Admit Week at Kingston. I'm just happy I can do the same for you.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah...

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: What's wrong, Sam?

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: So about that scholarship... I feel like... A fake.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: I mean, other people have actually worked hard for this scholarship, people who actually want to be actors and stuff.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Well, do you know what else you would want to be?

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: No.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Then you're not a fake!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: I'm not a fake even though I entered a fine arts program just to get money for college?

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: No! You're still trying to figure out if this is for you or not. `This` is what college is about. Exploring. Being curious. Learning.
nodes.text_bbcode: No! You're still trying to figure out if this is for you or not. [i]This[/i] is what college is about. Exploring. Being curious. Learning.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Now if you knew that you `hated` acting, and you still did this for the money, then you'd be a fake. But you're not.
nodes.text_bbcode: Now if you knew that you [i]hated[/i] acting, and you still did this for the money, then you'd be a fake. But you're not.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Great, so now I can't ever hate acting.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: I have a feeling you'll like it more than you think.
They arrive just outside the theater.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Well, wish me luck.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Break a leg! I'll see you after--
Suddenly, $ZOE's phone rings. She glances at the caller ID and smiles.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Who's calling? Is it Howard?

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: No, it's my dad! I'm taking this. You go have fun! Text me when you get out!
$ZOE presses the phone to her ear.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Dad?

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: ...What?! Why do you... How did you... What?
She turns and walks off.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Wonder what's going on...
Sam shrugs and enters the theater department.
Inside, Ms. Macbeth greets Sam.

nodes.speaker: Photo 1
nodes.text: Samantha! How delightfully enchanting it is to see you again!

nodes.speaker: Photo 1
nodes.text: I haven't had a chance to talk to you since we parted ways at the end of last year! How have you been?

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: I've been fantastic.
Ms. Macbeth puts a guiding arm around Sam and smiles down at her.

nodes.speaker: Photo 1
nodes.text: You know, your rendition of Romeo and Juliet was absolutely titillating! Having the kiss at the culmination of the entire play was truly romantic in a way I found utterly fascinating!

nodes.speaker: Photo 1
nodes.text: I'm quite excited to see the kind of exquisitely charming work you'll do for the fine arts program here at Centerscore U. Now, come this way...
Ms. Macbeth guides her back to the green room where a group of about ten students mills about.

nodes.speaker: Photo 1
nodes.text: Samantha, here are other winners of the Shakespeare Scholarship. Why don't you introduce yourself while I start setting things up for the seminar?
She hurries away, leaving Sam to introduce herself.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Now what do I do?
Sam glances around at the group of students and sees one girl smile at her and walk over.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Hey there, I didn't see you five minutes ago! You must have just come in!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: I'm Trisha.

menu.text: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: Still deciding, you know?

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: But I know one thing's for sure...

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: And oh look, it's $ZOE and Sam!
Amanda points to Sam and $ZOE, who are both with a very dramatic group of people.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Wow, Sam, taste these snacks! These are the most delicious brownies I've ever had in my mouth ever!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: I'd believe you more if you hadn't said that about the last twenty snacks we've tried.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Ha ha, but oh wait! There are cupcakes too!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Have fun with those. I think I see some friends.
Sam and $ZOE walk over to Amanda and Hector.

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: Hey, guys. Where have you been all day?

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: In an acting seminar. Not as horrible as I thought it might be. How about you?
Just then, Hector comes running up!

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: Amanda? Are you bored? Are you thirsty? Here!
Hector hands Amanda a balloon and a drink!

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: Yay! A balloon!

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: You're the best, Hecky!
She gives him a big kiss!

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: You wouldn't believe the day I've just had...

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: It was M.A.N. versus B.R.B., all competing to get me to join!

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: Whee! Like a Hector tug-of-war!

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: Yeah. How was your day? I was thinking about you...

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: It was amazing! I saw Paula and got out of a lot of work, I gave Beth a makeover, `and` I did some poetry with Dinah!
nodes.text_bbcode: It was amazing! I saw Paula and got out of a lot of work, I gave Beth a makeover, [i]and[/i] I did some poetry with Dinah!

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: Dinah?

nodes.prompt: What do you want to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.text: And with that realization, she knows...

nodes.speaker: Photo 2
nodes.text: Excuse me?

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: You've never treated me nicely. It wasn't okay back then, but I accepted it because I was...

nodes.speaker: Photo 2
nodes.text: A doormat?

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: Nice!

nodes.speaker: Photo 2
nodes.text: And you think you've changed?

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: I `know` I've changed! Today proves that!
nodes.text_bbcode: I [i]know[/i] I've changed! Today proves that!

nodes.speaker: Photo 2
nodes.text: I have no idea what that means!

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: Well... You know that I just stood up to you!

nodes.speaker: Photo 2
nodes.text: Yeah. So... Are you going to do what I want you to or not?

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: No! I'm not! Because I'm a grown up now!

nodes.speaker: Photo 2
nodes.text: Sheesh. Whatever.
Paula marches over to another unsuspecting pledge.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: I did it! I stood up to Paula! Maybe I `am` more mature after all!
nodes.text_bbcode: I did it! I stood up to Paula! Maybe I [i]am[/i] more mature after all!

nodes.text: Amanda has failed.

nodes.text: By the time Amanda finishes baking cupcakes, the party is basically over...

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: Paula, I did everything you asked of me...

nodes.speaker: Photo 2
nodes.text: Good, we'll start again tomorrow. I have `so` many tasks!
nodes.text_bbcode: Good, we'll start again tomorrow. I have [i]so[/i] many tasks!

nodes.text: Under Paula's thumb, Amanda realizes that she'll...
As the party rages on, Amanda goes through the painstaking process of trimming all the flowers.

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: Flowers are pretty, but I hate this!
After a long time trimming, Amanda is finally ready to party. Unfortunately...

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: I still have to bake cupcakes!
One by one, Amanda moves the chairs as Paula commanded.

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: This isn't fun at all...
When Amanda finishes, she finds a pair of scissors.

nodes.speaker: Photo 2
nodes.text: Your next instruction is to get started on what I asked you to! Now!
Amanda hustles off to a stack of chairs in the corner!

nodes.speaker: Photo 2
